items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: at that time Mayor Lindsay had a program on Sunday

ctx.x: The Newport Jazz Festival. And at that time Mayor Lindsay had a program on Sunday. It was a, you know, program with people from different walks of life, and by the festival starting at just about that time, well I think he had several folks there from the jazz festival. He interviewed them on his show. And Charlie Mingus was there and I think -- oh, I can't think of the other trumpet player's name right now, but another very fine trumpet player was on there, and several -- well, about four or five of the other…
